''See also: [[Sandborn Hydra Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Sandborn Hydra is a type of [[Kameira]], a class of non-human or non-Elder creatures capable of manipulating the world through supernatural means. Native to the [[Izyrian]] desert, this entity possesses a unique [[Intent]] that allows it to manipulate its own weight. In the wild, it can move across sand dunes without leaving any traces or disturbance, yet it is capable of striking with the massive force of a collapsing temple. In the context of [[Soulbound]], the Hydra serves as a powerful [[Vessel]]—an [[Awakened object]] that grants its user specific abilities. When channeled, the Hydra provides immense physical strength and durability, often accompanied by a predatory fury that can overwhelm the user. This power can manifest as an increase in physical weight and toughness, making the wielder feel heavy and nearly invulnerable. For some users, such as [[Urzaia Woodsman]], the Hydra is a formidable and ancient internal adversary that must be constantly fought to maintain control.}}
